messages.subject: [Traminer-users] multichannel and aggregate cases
messages.body_plain:
I am
working with a big data frame and you recommended me to use weightCluster and
aggregate cases. It worked very well for me but now I want to use Multichannel Sequence
Analysis and I don't find the way to use aggregate cases for the three
dimensions (channels) that I am using. ?Is it possible to aggregate cases for
the three sequence object?

 

Thanks

 

Karina
